q: How far above the roof must a firewall extend?
o: It stops at the roof line
n: A firewall extends 400 to 1,000 mm above the roof, or to the top of the parapet where the roof has one, and carries no openings except permitted vent wells.
ref: PD 1096 National Building Code, Revised IRR (2004), Rule VII - firewalls

q: What is the minimum thickness of a footing for a Group A dwelling?
n: Footings for Group A dwellings must be at least 250 mm thick and set 600 mm below the ground surface.
ref: PD 1096 National Building Code, Revised IRR (2004), Rule VII Sec. 708 - minimum requirements for Group A dwellings

q: How far below the ground surface must a Group A dwelling footing be set?
n: The Code sets the footing 600 mm below the ground surface, with a minimum thickness of 250 mm.
ref: PD 1096 National Building Code, Revised IRR (2004), Rule VII Sec. 708 - minimum requirements for Group A dwellings

q: What is the minimum clear width of a stairway in a Group A dwelling?
n: Group A dwelling stairs need 750 mm of clear width, with a 200 mm rise and a minimum 200 mm run.
ref: PD 1096 National Building Code, Revised IRR (2004), Rule VII Sec. 708 - minimum requirements for Group A dwellings

q: What openings are allowed in a four-hour fire-resistive occupancy separation?
o: Openings with a four-hour fire assembly
Openings up to 25% of the wall length
Openings with a three-hour fire assembly
n: A four-hour fire-resistive occupancy separation has no openings and is built of not less than four-hour fire-resistive construction. The one-, two- and three-hour separations allow openings protected by matching fire assemblies.
ref: PD 1096 National Building Code, Revised IRR (2004), Rule VII - occupancy separation

q: Which Rule of the National Building Code IRR sets the Allowable Maximum Total Gross Floor Area (TGFA)?
n: Rule VII holds the development controls, including Table VII.1 for the allowable maximum TGFA, which is then crosschecked against the Allowable Maximum Volume of Building.
ref: PD 1096 National Building Code, Revised IRR (2004), Rule VII, Table VII.1 - allowable maximum TGFA

q: What is the minimum clear width of a door under the 2024 Revised IRR of BP 344?
n: All doors need a minimum clear width of 900 mm. Older reviewers still quote the 800 mm of the superseded 1983 IRR.

q: At what height must door handles, pulls, latches and lever locksets be installed under the 2024 Revised IRR of BP 344?
n: The 2024 IRR fixes them at 900 mm above the floor. The 820 to 1,060 mm range in older reviewers comes from the superseded 1983 IRR.
ref: BP 344, 2024 Revised IRR, Sec. 2.11 - door hardware

q: At what height must a lavatory be mounted under the 2024 Revised IRR of BP 344?
n: Lavatories are mounted 800 mm from the finished floor, with a vertical clear leg room not lower than 650 mm.
